$comment: Any renewable power source that includes a power controller

integrationCycle.description: Renewable power sources typically have a cyclic pattern.  To calculate energy balance, the duration of a cycle must be known.  For example, a solar panel will typically have an integration cycle of 24hrs.  A generator that is only run once a week woud have a week. A hydro system might depend on annual rainfall, and therefore have an integratoin cycle of a year.
